tasks.title: Lease table, Lease type and token-keyed store operations

Run the tests until they pass; run make test and make lint

tasks.title: Validate the POST body: fields, profile, ttl, purpose, labels
steps: Write TS-26-17 to TS-26-23 through the POST handler and confirm they fail

Decode the body with json.Decoder and DisallowUnknownFields into a struct with profile, purpose, ttl and labels; an empty body is {}; a non-object, malformed JSON or unknown field answers 400 whose message names the unknown field
Profile: exact case-sensitive lookup; unknown name or absent without default answers 400 listing every profile name in configuration order
ttl: time.ParseDuration, minimum 1 minute, at most the profile TTL; 400 otherwise, and the too-long message names the profile TTL
purpose: at most 64 runes (utf8.RuneCountInString) and no control characters (unicode.IsControl)

labels: at most 16 pairs, string values only (decode as map[string]any and check types), key regexp ^[A-Za-z0-9]([A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,61}[A-Za-z0-9])?$ or a single alphanumeric, reject lease/workspace case-insensitively, value at most 256 bytes without control characters; every violation names the label key
Validation runs after the workspace checks and before the secret check; nothing is stored on refusal
Run the tests, make test and make lint
done_when: 16 labels, a 63-character key, a 256-byte value, a 64-rune purpose and ttl 1m are accepted
